acceptance_test: Ludlum or equivalent portal monitor full checkout completed including foot-level detector response
Handheld survey meters used at documented rate and proximity
Wipe-down cloth surveyed after cleaning potentially contaminated portal monitor
Vehicle monitoring/decon path demonstrated or procedurally proven with equipment
Secondary monitoring and referral path for contaminated evacuees documented
Staff use checklist/procedure rather than memory-only execution
Calibration/source-check status and instrument inventory captured
Facility throughput linked to EPZ population/transients and 12-hour monitoring objective
Any failure has training, redemonstration, evaluator note, and closure proof
Referral and decontamination records protect privacy while retaining auditability
